title: Víctor García Carrasco
text:
PhD · Statistics & Operations Research
Víctor García Carrasco
Simulation, predictive modelling and optimisation for energy and water systems
I’m a physicist with a PhD from the Universitat Politècnica de Catalunya (UPC), where I teach simulation and combinatorial optimisation. For years I’ve built models to understand complex systems and make better decisions, from the spread of an epidemic to the Iberian electricity mix and water management in Catalonia. Now I want to bring that toolkit to applied problems in industry.
Lecturer at UPC · Open to industry roles in energy, data science and R&D · Barcelona area

 GitHub  LinkedIn  iD ORCID  Email

title: Víctor García Carrasco
text:
What I do




Simulation
Discrete-event, system dynamics, agent-based models and digital twins.





Predictive modelling
Time series, regression and autoregressive models, machine learning and deep learning.





Optimisation
Combinatorial and multi-objective optimisation. Metaheuristics (genetic algorithms, particle swarm), exact methods and Bayesian search.





Energy & water
Iberian electricity mix, wholesale prices, storage and the water–energy nexus.





Scientific software
Fast, production-ready Python: vectorisation, Numba, memoisation and parallel processing. LLM-assisted development of web front ends.





Quantitative finance
Portfolio management, asset allocation and quantitative analysis.

title: Projects
text:
Featured




OR Labs
An operations research web platform that I designed, built and deployed end to end. It hosts four interactive tools in English, Spanish and Catalan, free to use without signing up and with extended access for students. Front ends built with LLM-assisted development.

Python Web apps Simulation Optimisation


orlabs.cloud →






Almaraz nuclear phase-out
Co-author, with Eloy Sanz (URJC), of the Greenpeace Spain report Cierre nuclear y transición energética: el caso de Almaraz (2026). I built the hourly electricity-market model: wholesale prices driven by gas prices, with battery damping calibrated on CAISO data, comparing closure and extension scenarios for Almaraz I and II.

Electricity markets Scenario analysis Storage


Read the report →






Water–energy nexus of Catalonia
PhD project. An hourly simulation model integrating renewable generation, electricity demand, reservoirs and desalination, with multi-objective optimisation of transition scenarios (emissions, cost and water security). Proposes opportunistic desalination: desalinate when renewables are in surplus.

Hourly simulation Multi-objective Water

Reservoir volume forecasting
Predictive model of the water stored in the reservoirs of Catalonia’s internal river basins, developed as part of the PhD.
